title: Gloomy weather across Saskatchewan delays Saskatoon berry season - 650 CKOM
summary: The Berry Barn in Saskatoon, which usually harvests between 15,000 and 20,000 pounds in a season, says the weeks of rain and cloud cover have pushed Saskatoon berry season back by at least a week.
